papers.title: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
papers.abstract: Framework enabling robot policies to infer system variables from self-generated interactions, allowing adaptation to novel configurations without parameter updates by treating system identification as an in-context adaptation problem.

papers.title: The Verification Horizon: No Silver Bullet for Coding Agent Rewards
papers.abstract: Examines verification challenges in AI agents, showing that proxy signals diverge from human intent, requiring adaptive verification systems that evolve alongside generative capabilities to prevent reward hacking.

papers.title: JetSpec: Breaking the Scaling Ceiling of Speculative Decoding with Parallel Tree Drafting
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding framework combining efficient forward drafting with causal conditioning to improve LLM inference speed and acceptance rates, achieving up to 9.64x speedup on mathematical benchmarks.

papers.title: GUI vs. CLI: Execution Bottlenecks in Screen-Only and Skill-Mediated Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Matched benchmark comparing GUI and CLI agent execution, revealing that GUI agents struggle with long-horizon grounded interaction while CLI agents face skill coverage limitations.

papers.title: Running the Gauntlet: Re-evaluating the Capabilities of Agents Beyond Familiar Environments
papers.abstract: Web-based benchmark evaluating agent generalization across challenging scenarios, revealing significant gaps between current agentic systems and human performance in temporal perception and 3D reasoning.

papers.title: LISA: Likelihood Score Alignment for Visual-condition Controllable Generation
papers.abstract: Regularization method aligning intermediate features with likelihood scores, accelerating training convergence and improving synthetic results across various image/video generation tasks with negligible overhead.

papers.title: Information-Aware KV Cache Compression for Long Reasoning
papers.abstract: Entropy-aware KV cache compression framework incorporating information-theoretic signals alongside attention weights to improve long-context reasoning in LLMs across multiple model architectures.

papers.title: Confidence-Aware Tool Orchestration for Robust Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Framework addressing the Blind Trust Problem by integrating per-frame trustworthiness into video reasoning, improving accuracy under realistic perturbations like motion blur and occlusion.

papers.title: Hallucination in World Models is Predictable and Preventable
papers.abstract: Analysis showing world model hallucinations concentrate in low-data regions, proposing coverage-aware sampling and data-centric signals for detection and mitigation.

papers.title: Discretizing Reward Models
papers.abstract: Demonstrates that continuous reward models suffer from oversensitivity, proposing discretization techniques using Monte Carlo dropout to reduce reward hacking while maintaining discriminative ability.

cc_updates.body: Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS to disable mouse click/drag/hover in fullscreen mode. Fixed hook matchers with hyphenated identifiers accidentally substring-matching. Fixed voice dictation on macOS capturing silence in long-running sessions. Fixed voice dictation auto-submit never firing for Japanese, Chinese, Thai. Fixed external plugins not requiring install consent. Fixed /plugin Enable/Disable not working. Fixed background jobs disappearing from claude agents. Fixed reopening a crashed background task showing blank screen.

Added autoMode.classifyAllShell setting to route all Bash/PowerShell through auto-mode classifier. Added auto-mode denial reasons to transcript. Added claude_code.assistant_response OpenTelemetry log event. Added live file path autocomplete to bash mode. Added startup notice when MCP servers need authentication. Added automatic memory-pressure reaping for idle background shell commands. Fixed /model and client-data-gated UI showing stale state. Fixed backgrounding spuriously cancelling. Fixed pinned background agents being re-prompted after auto-update.

Added /rewind support for resuming conversation from before /clear. Fixed scroll position jumping to bottom during streaming response. Fixed background agents resurrecting after being stopped. Fixed /voice showing generic message when disabled by org policy. Fixed /login URL truncated in Windows Terminal. Fixed Cmd+click on links in fullscreen Ghostty over ssh/tmux. Fixed claude agents sending builtin slash commands to background sessions. Fixed hooks with comma-separated matchers silently never firing.
